'''Maeve''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]], after the Coronation of Empress [[Vaylin]] she went into exile following the disgraced Battalion Commander [[Tassar (Human)|Tassar]]. Tassar and her [[Zakuulan Forward Recon|followers]] made significant progress in constructing a new [[Star Fortress]] on [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime's]] surface, however following the death of Vaylin in [[3630 BBY]] they were discovered by the [[Eternal Alliance]] forces. A strike team was [[Battle on Rakata Prime|dispatched]] to stop Tassar and her efforts, but before the strike team could confront Maeve, a gargantuan [[jurgoran]] killed her.<ref name="SWTOR" />
